item.kubejs.summon_fire_boss: Summon: Echo of Telos - The Primordial Fire-Receiver
trait.kubejs.wisp_guardian.desc: Summons wisps every 5 seconds to attack nearby enemies.
trait.kubejs.ghost_player.desc: Summons a clone to fight for you when damaged. CD: 10s
trait.kubejs.gravity_anchor.desc: Bow attacks apply Gravity Anchor to the target, attracting all nearby projectiles to the affected entity.
trait.kubejs.ultimine_test.desc: Attempts to chain-mine blocks when mining, if possible.
trait.kubejs.moonpools.desc: When held, the weapon slowly repairs at night, the holder slowly regenerates health, and receives 25% damage reduction.
trait.kubejs.minion_capacity.desc: Increases your maximum minion capacity. Requires 1 point to gain +1 minion.
trait.kubejs.fire_dragon_blood.desc: Press the 'Release Affix Spell' keybind to unleash Fire Dragon Breath.
trait.kubejs.ice_dragon_blood.desc: Press the 'Release Affix Spell' keybind to unleash Ice Dragon Breath.
trait.kubejs.lightning_dragon_blood.desc: Press the 'Release Affix Spell' keybind to unleash Lightning Dragon Breath.
trait.kubejs.sea_serpent_scales.desc: Gains damage boost over time when submerged in water.
trait.kubejs.pest_emperor.desc: Gains Pest Defense over time; attacks apply Pest Infesting.
trait.kubejs.systemtime: Silence! Time is Mine to Allocate!
trait.kubejs.systemtime.desc: Attack damage varies based on real-world time. At midnight (0:00) or noon (12:00), damage +20%. Each minute away from these times reduces the bonus by ~0.0556% (0% after 6 hours).
trait.kubejs.strange_crystal.desc: Each attack has a <Trait Level> x 10% chance to steal the target's essence. Success triggers a 3-second cooldown.
trait.kubejs.strikesoul.desc: Killing a creature drops an essence.
trait.kubejs.luminofish_ink_sac.desc: On attack, consumes Poison levels equal to Affix Level x 2, dealing magic damage based on consumed stacks.
trait.kubejs.hallowed_ingot.desc: Every 30 seconds, gain immunity to the next attack.
trait.kubejs.shadow_snail_shell.desc: Sneaking grants 85% damage reduction, but also reduces damage dealt by 85%.
trait.kubejs.dreadsteel_ingot.desc: Attacks apply Fear to the target.
trait.kubejs.calamatium_ingot.desc: For every burning entity within 5 blocks, grant all players in that range a Health Boost effect for 10 seconds. Level = Trait Level + number of burning entities.
trait.kubejs.gobber: May Your Journey Be Filled with Curses and Blessings I
trait.kubejs.gobber.desc: Attacks gain 10% independent damage bonus. Synergizes with other Gobber affixes.
trait.kubejs.gobber_end: May Your Journey Be Filled with Curses and Blessings III
trait.kubejs.gobber_end.desc: Attacks gain 30% independent damage bonus. Synergizes with other Gobber affixes.
trait.kubejs.gobber_nether: May Your Journey Be Filled with Curses and Blessings II
trait.kubejs.gobber_nether.desc: Attacks gain 20% independent damage bonus. Synergizes with other Gobber affixes.
trait.kubejs.high_health.desc: Deals extra damage against high-health enemies.
trait.kubejs.unstable_luminescence_ingot: Increases your healing received multiplier and armor value.
trait.kubejs.starinium_ingot.desc: Scarlet spells cast by the player have their spell power increased by [10x Trait Level]%, but each cast deals [Trait Level x 3] bleed damage to the caster.
trait.kubejs.eternal_starlight.desc: When in the Starlight dimension, gain 10% melee damage per level. Outside, gain 10% attack speed per level.
trait.kubejs.neptunium_ingot.desc: Attacks have a chance to apply Decay.
trait.kubejs.sleep_aid.desc: Grants a Protection effect after sleeping.
trait.kubejs.ponder_up.desc: Launches hit entities into the air.
trait.kubejs.exalted_beauty_gem.desc: Has a (Effect Level × 2)% chance to fully negate damage by consuming 10 experience levels.
trait.kubejs.boron_ingot.desc: Attacking enemies reduces their maximum health.
trait.kubejs.cosmos_aurora_ingot.desc: During rain, spell attack power increases by [10x Trait Level]% and Lightning spell power increases by [10x Trait Level]%.
trait.kubejs.fiery_tears.desc: Sanity ≥ 0: Gain Protection status. Attack -10%, gain 1 level of Protection, gain Fire Resistance, Fire spell power +10%. Sanity < 0: Gain Despair status. Attack +30%, periodically gain Fiery Strike. Fiery attacks apply [Affix Level × 10] level Burn. Immune to Seven Deadly Sins Erosion.
trait.kubejs.lacrima.desc: Sanity ≥ 0: Gain Protection status. Attack -20%, gain 1 level of Guardian (Damage reduction = level %). Sanity < 0: Gain Despair status. Attack +30%, become Vulnerable. Immune to Seven Deadly Sins Erosion.
trait.kubejs.twin_shadows.desc: Increases attack speed but reduces damage.
trait.kubejs.wip.desc: Due to development constraints, this trait is not final and may be changed or removed in future updates. This does not mean only materials with this trait will be changed.
trait.kubejs.mana_quenching.desc: After casting Fire spells, has a chance to restore mana.
trait.kubejs.meat_ingots.desc: Every <6 - Affix Level> seconds: - Consumes <Affix Level>² durability - Attempts to heal the player (consumes durability even at full health).
trait.kubejs.combustion_boost.desc: Hitting entities with burning effects has a 'Affix Level × 10%' chance to increase their Burn level by 1. If the target is burning, extends the burn duration (up to 40 seconds).
trait.kubejs.bribery.desc: Giving gifts to villagers restores health and 1 Sanity, and grants the Hero of the Village effect for 30 seconds.
trait.kubejs.starfire.desc: Your attacks are imbued with Starfire.
trait.kubejs.comet_trait.desc: Bow attacks cause falling stars to strike the target.
trait.kubejs.monkey.desc: While on ladders or vines, attacks perform an additional arrow attack dealing half the current base damage (ignoring effects).
trait.kubejs.vorant_ingot.desc: (Weapons/Tools only) Killing creatures permanently increases base damage and heals. Killing players permanently increases final damage and heals based on their max health. Losing some kill count upon death.
trait.kubejs.demonite_ingot.desc: (Weapons/Tools only) Mining blocks accumulates energy up to <Trait Level> × 10000. Mining with energy restores health or hunger. Taking damage consumes energy to reduce damage and convert it to healing.
trait.kubejs.promotion.desc: 'Unique' Increases the level of your affixes by 1 when calculating affix levels.
trait.kubejs.celeslar_ingot.desc: For each creature within 2 × <Affix Level> range, gain 1 level of damage boost, up to a maximum of 3 × <Affix Level>.
trait.kubejs.xelkive_ingot.desc: Every 15 - (Affix Level * 5) seconds, automatically remove one negative effect from yourself.
trait.kubejs.void_ingot.desc: Increases your hit invulnerability frames. If your light level is lower than the target's, each point of light difference grants 10% extra damage per trait level, up to a maximum of 150%.
trait.kubejs.echo_ingot.desc: Makes you immune to darkness. Hitting a target applies <Affix Level> Slowness, <Affix Level> Paralysis, and <Affix Level>*2 Bleed. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
trait.kubejs.farmersdelight.desc: You are a farmer's son. You cannot kill whoever you want.
trait.kubejs.blazing_magic_set.desc: After casting a Fire spell: [Trait Level] × 20% chance to gain 1 stack of Blazing Magic (stacks up to 10).
trait.kubejs.arcane_ingot.desc: Provides damage boost based on current mana. +1% damage per 10 mana, up to (Affix Level × 20)%. Reduces damage by 20% when mana is below 50.
trait.kubejs.knockback.desc: Reduces user movement speed, but attacks pull enemies towards the user. Pull force: 1.0 + (0.5 × Effect Level).
trait.kubejs.lunium_nova_ingot.desc: Grants buffs or debuffs based on the current moon phase.
trait.kubejs.dragonskill.desc: Attacks against dragon-type creatures deal +10 damage per hit, stacking up to 5 times.
trait.kubejs.dragonsteel_lightning_ingot: Attacks apply a stack of High Voltage. Hitting a High Voltage target deals 20 damage to nearby enemies without High Voltage and applies High Voltage to them. Reaching a certain stack count deals Lightning damage and clears the effect. Attacks also inflict Bleed. When Bleed reaches 10 stacks, consume 8 stacks to grant a one-time (10-second) Absorption shield.
trait.kubejs.dragonsteel_ice_ingot.desc: Attacks apply a stack of Frost. At 10 stacks, freeze the target. Attacking a frozen target deals +20 Frost damage and removes the freeze. Attacks also inflict Bleed. When Bleed reaches 10 stacks, grant a one-time (10-second) Absorption shield.
trait.kubejs.dragonsteel_fire_ingot.desc: Attacks apply a stack of Armor Break. When armor is broken, ignite the target for 60 seconds. Attacking ignited targets with broken armor deals extra magic damage and removes the burn. Attacks also inflict Bleed. When Bleed reaches 10 stacks, consume 8 stacks to grant 20 Golden Hearts.
trait.kubejs.polonium_ingot.desc: Hitting targets with poison or radiation effects triggers Elemental Harmony.
trait.kubejs.radiance.desc: Attacks apply Radiance. Higher levels apply additional debuffs.
trait.silentgear.acril_ingot.desc: Consumes 20 mana on attack: Releases a [Trait Level +1] level Chain Lightning. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
trait.silentgear.amns.desc: Typing 'amns' in chat: Grants a random vanilla potion effect.
trait.silentgear.ancient_metal_ingot.des: As sanity fluctuates, attacks have a chance to drive the target mad, causing them to attack indiscriminately for a short time.
trait.silentgear.animated_steel_ingot.de: Per level of Sharpness: Deals (0.5 × level + 0.5) extra damage. Attacks have [Trait Level × 10%] chance to restore 1-3 durability.
trait.silentgear.aquamarine.desc: Randomly consumes 1-10 extra durability to increase damage multiplier by 0.1.
trait.silentgear.arrow.desc: When hit by arrows: 10% chance to fully block. On successful block, restore 10% health.
trait.silentgear.attack_taunt.desc: Attack -20%, but attacks have a chance to apply Taunt.
trait.silentgear.bismuthgems.desc: Hitting targets with armor value less than [Trait Level × 4] deals +10 extra damage.
trait.silentgear.bloodjade_set.desc: Every 5 attacks: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's max health, while also dealing 50% of the user's max health to themselves.
trait.silentgear.carbonatite_ingot.desc: Sneak + Right-click weapon: Gains 1 level of a random enchantment. Each upgrade consumes Current Durability × 10% (minimum 1). Cannot upgrade if durability is insufficient.
trait.silentgear.citrine.desc: +1 Attack Damage per 30 experience levels (up to level 900).
trait.kubejs.corroded.desc: Lower weapon durability = higher damage: Durability ≤ 20%: Damage × 1.25; 20%~50%: Damage × 1.1; ≥ 50%: No bonus.
trait.silentgear.cursium_ingot.desc: Grants Ghost Form periodically, but cannot use the cursed soul resurrection effect.
trait.silentgear.dropped_experience.desc: Absorbs more experience from defeated enemies.
trait.silentgear.emerald.desc: Every 2 seconds: Consumes 4 durability from the main hand weapon to grant Hero of the Village.
trait.silentgear.enderman.desc: Eating teleports you randomly like an Enderman.
trait.silentgear.exalted_beauty_gem.desc: Has a (Effect Level × 2)% chance to fully negate damage by consuming 10 experience levels.
trait.silentgear.exp_to_death.desc: On fatal damage: Consumes all experience levels to gain 'Experience Level' levels of Absorption for 'Experience Level' / 5 seconds.
trait.silentgear.frosted_helve.desc: The cold handle holds magical energy, increasing mana capacity and regeneration, and boosting frost spells.
trait.silentgear.garnet.desc: When ignited: Melee attacks trigger [Trait Level +1] level Flare. Cooldown: 5 seconds. Does not consume mana.
trait.silentgear.gift_heaven.desc: On near-death: Consumes your Silent Gear equipment to negate the fatal attack.
trait.silentgear.ignitium_ingot.desc: Your attacks apply the corresponding level of Fiery Gaze.
trait.silentgear.intrinsic.desc: +1% damage per 5 experience levels (up to level 900).
trait.silentgear.iridescence.desc: Damage dealt is increased by a random value between [Trait Level] and [Trait Level + 6].
trait.silentgear.ironwood_ingot.desc: Consumes 15 Sanity on attack to release Entangling Vines. Gains 80% damage reduction during the cast. Insufficient Sanity: - Consumes 40% max health - Forces 1 Vine cast (toggleable).
trait.silentgear.lacrima.desc: Sanity ≥ 0: Gain Protection status. Attack -20%, gain 1 level of Guardian (Damage reduction = level %). Sanity < 0: Gain Despair status. Attack +30%, become Vulnerable. Immune to Seven Deadly Sins Erosion.
trait.silentgear.life_drain.desc: Attacks apply Frenzy to self, reducing 2% health per second. Attacks stack the effect but do not increase self-damage. Max 5 stacks. At 5 stacks, the attack deals 300% damage.
trait.silentgear.luck.desc: Attacks have a 10% × Effect Level chance to trigger, dealing additional (20×Level - Luck Value)% damage. Minimum 5% damage bonus.
Scythe proficiency +35%. Soul system enhancements: - Base shield +20 - Recovery rate +25% - Stability +20% - Essence effect strength +25%. Attacks apply Silence.
trait.silentgear.meat_ingots.desc: Every <6 - Affix Level> seconds: - Consumes <Affix Level>² durability - Attempts to heal the player (consumes durability even at full health).
trait.silentgear.mithril_ingot.desc: On taking damage: - Restores health equal to 50% of the damage taken. - Consumes mana equal to restored health × 10 (fails if mana is insufficient).
trait.silentgear.moonstone.desc: Day: Attack damage -10%/level. Night: Attack +2 + 2/level magic damage.
trait.silentgear.multicolor.desc: On attack, applies one of the following randomly: Weakness, Slowness, Wither, Bleed.
trait.silentgear.naughty.desc: When holding a 'Noob' quality weapon, each attack has a 0.005% chance to fully heal the user and nullify the damage dealt.
trait.silentgear.nightfall_spider_eye.de: Provides resistance to glowing and gaze effects.
trait.silentgear.overload.desc: If total buffs and debuffs exceed 8, gain immunity to normal knockback and 100x Affix Level% movement speed. Triggering this effect consumes 50% of current health.
trait.silentgear.pearl.desc: Increases your luck, but taking damage applies Bad Luck.
trait.kubejs.prismarine_crystals.desc: Grants Conduit Power while in water.
trait.silentgear.set_numbness.desc: On hit: Target gains 1.5 seconds of 'Numbness', self gains Speed I for 3 seconds.
trait.silentgear.set_ponder.desc: Attacks apply 'Ponder' to the target. Effect depends on trait level.
trait.silentgear.shivering_gel.desc: Every 5 seconds, applies 2 levels of Slowness to units within 5 blocks that have Tremor level ≥ 10.
trait.silentgear.six_life_death_set.desc: Each attack applies 1 'Death Mark' stack to the target. At 36 stacks: Consumes 5% of self health to deal Void damage equal to consumed health × 5 to the target.
trait.kubejs.spell_level_up.desc: Spell level +2 when casting, but mana cost +50.
trait.silentgear.spinel.desc: Continuously gains Strength [Trait Level +1], but attacks have a 20% chance to be nullified.
trait.silentgear.strip.desc: Attacking full-health targets deals [Trait Level + 5] extra damage.
trait.silentgear.systemtime: Silence! Time is Mine to Allocate!
trait.silentgear.systemtime.desc: Attack damage varies based on real-world time. At midnight (0:00) or noon (12:00), damage +75%. Each minute away from these times reduces the bonus by 0.208% (0% after 6 hours).
trait.silentgear.tanzanite.desc: On attack, applies one random debuff: Slowness, Weakness, Mining Fatigue, Nausea, Blindness, Wither, Poison, Darkness, Bleed. Duration = Level × 5 seconds, Intensity = Level - 1.
trait.silentgear.tooth_of_hunger.desc: Each attack consumes (Level + 1) hunger and boosts damage. Can cause self-damage when full. When hungry, more likely to bite enemies and restore (Level + 1) hunger. At extreme hunger: 40% chance to take 1 extra self-damage. Effect scales with trait level.
trait.silentgear.topaz.desc: If remaining weapon durability is a multiple of 12, attacks deal extra damage. +10 damage per level.
trait.silentgear.amber.desc: On taking damage, has a [Trait Level × 10%] chance to gain: Strength III + Speed III (5 seconds).
trait.silentgear.wither_howitzer.desc: Gain 1 Wither Shell every 20 seconds (max 8). Use weapon skill key: - Consumes 1 to launch self - Gain Speed II for 3 seconds. On attack: - Consumes 1 to deal heavy knockback - Deals +20% damage (independent multiplier).
trait.silentgear.witherbone.desc: Attacking any entity grants the user damage boosts and regeneration based on the target's Wither level.
trait.silentgear.wolf.desc: Each time you take damage, summon a tamed wolf.
trait.silentgear.fluxing.desc: Deals 1 + (0.2 × Level) times damage to enemies on fire/in lava.
trait.silentgear.tenacious_vine.desc: On hit, releases moonlit thorns that slow enemies.
trait.silentgear.soul_dew.desc: Increases essence gathering efficiency and scythe mastery.
trait.silentgear.atalphaite.desc: Attacks deal +25% base damage and create a small area explosion (50% damage). Explosion damage continues to chain (damage reduced by 50% each time).
trait.silentgear.wind_blast.desc: Releases a strong gust of wind on attack.
trait.silentgear.lunium_nova.desc: Increases soul shield capacity and recovery rate.
trait.silentgear.xeproda.desc: Entities you look at are periodically afflicted with Gaze.
trait.silentgear.hallowed_gold_ingot.des: Increases scythe mastery and holy spell power.
trait.silentgear.golem_steel_ingot.desc: Increases draw speed and projectile damage.
trait.silentgear.soul_stained_steel_ingo: Increases scythe mastery, soul shield capacity, recovery rate, and extra strength of effects triggered by collected essence.
trait.silentgear.fortunate.desc: Mining blocks drops extra items, similar to Fortune enchantment (does not stack with enchantments).
trait.silentgear.thermal_springstone_ing: On attack: Ignites target for 3 seconds. If already burning: Deals 15% × Level extra damage. Self burning: Adds 1/3 of base damage as fire damage.
trait.silentgear.malarite.desc: Your attacks apply Poison. If the target is already poisoned, grant self 'Spider's Bane' for Affix Level × 2 seconds / level.
trait.silentgear.heat_resistant.desc: Reduces fire damage. Items are not destroyed by fire or lava.
trait.silentgear.combustion_boost.desc: Your attacks extend the burn duration of the target.
trait.silentgear.swamp_silver_ingot.desc: Makes you immune to certain potion effects.
trait.silentgear.aethersent_ingot.desc: On taking damage, summons a meteor shower to attack enemies.
trait.silentgear.achroous_ingot: I Can Count to Ten with One Hand
trait.silentgear.achroous_ingot.desc: Attack speed increased by [Trait Level / 2], but each attack has a [Trait Level × 10%] chance to take 5 magic damage. Also inflicts Nausea I and Weakness I for 3 seconds every 5 seconds to creatures within 5 blocks.
You have a 1% chance to deal 300% damage with the current weapon.
trait.silentgear.max_health.desc: Your attacks deal 1/2/3% of the target's current health (cannot bypass damage limits).
trait.silentgear.magic_blood.desc: All your Scarlet spells are increased by 1/2/3 levels. You can use Scarlet spells you don't know.
trait.silentgear.magic_ender.desc: All your Ender spells are increased by 1/2/3 levels. You can use Ender spells you don't know.
trait.silentgear.magic_holy.desc: All your Holy spells are increased by 1/2/3 levels. You can use Holy spells you don't know.
trait.silentgear.magic_lightning.desc: All your Lightning spells are increased by 1/2/3 levels. You can use Lightning spells you don't know.
trait.silentgear.magic_ice.desc: All your Frost spells are increased by 1/2/3 levels. You can use Frost spells you don't know.
trait.silentgear.magic_fire.desc: All your Fire spells are increased by 1/2/3 levels. You can use Fire spells you don't know.
trait.silentgear.magic_nature.desc: All your Nature spells are increased by 1/2/3 levels. You can use Nature spells you don't know.
trait.silentgear.magic_eldritch.desc: All your Eldritch spells are increased by 1/2/3 levels. You can use Eldritch spells you don't know.
trait.silentgear.lucky.desc: Increases luck when held (Note: differs from Fortune).
trait.kubejs.nlatstone_ingot.desc: If your light level is higher than the target's, each point of light difference grants 10% extra damage per trait level, up to a maximum of 150%.

patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.swo: $(#FFA500)Deals +150$(ovo) damage to Soul Shields. Each level of Burn on the target increases damage to Soul Shields by +15$(ovo) (max +300$(ovo)).$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Placeholder.

patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.rad: $(#FFA500)On attack, applies 5 seconds of 'Mute' to the target.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Placeholder.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.fir: $(#FFA500)Ignites nearby entities for 3 seconds every 5 seconds.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Placeholder.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.san: $(#FFA500)If the player's Sanity is non-positive (does not apply at 0), each attack applies Slowness and deals 25$(ovo) extra damage.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Placeholder.

patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.cor: $(#FFA500)When hit by a player, damages the attacker's main hand item durability by 1$(ovo).$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Weapons rust quickly against this foe.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.tra: $(#FFA500)On attack, applies 5 seconds of Tremor. Effect is reduced when blocked. Halved against non-Netherite monsters. Netherite monsters below 50$(ovo) health slow down players within 6 blocks every 5 seconds.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Tremor Unending.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.lic: $(#FFA500)On attack, applies a random negative effect for 5 seconds. If already present, increases its level. When healed, gains a random positive effect for 5 seconds. If already present, increases its level.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)A necromancer skilled in curses and blessings.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.ref: $(#FFA500)When hit by a player, reflects 25$(ovo) damage back to the attacker (max 15$(ovo) of the attacker's max health). If the attacker's health is below 2, deals Current Health + 1 damage.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Turnabout is fair play.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.par: $(#FFA500)Has a chance to fully block attacks based on the monster's dodge rate.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Expert in defensive techniques.

message.sin.gluttony.message.0: Your digestive system starts to twist and warp, teeth become sharp...
message.sin.gluttony.message.1: Excessive saliva fills your mouth; everything before you looks... delicious...
message.sin.gluttony.message.2: A primal urge to consume dominates your mind.
message.sin.gluttony.message.3: You suddenly understand the creatures that go mad for food.
message.sin.pride.message.0: A surge of superiority wells up; you feel more noble than everyone around you.
message.sin.pride.message.1: You begin to despise all life forms, including your past self...
message.sin.pride.message.2: A monstrous pride of the mind seems to trample the frailty of the body.
message.sin.pride.message.3: Suddenly, everyone else seems so... mediocre...
message.sin.wrath.message.0: A nameless rage suddenly flares up; you want to destroy everything in sight.
message.sin.wrath.message.1: Molten fury named wrath surges through shattered veins.
message.sin.wrath.message.2: Countless violent scenes flash through your mind, each one bringing you pleasure.
message.sin.wrath.message.3: Blood seems to boil, craving the sight of enemies' pain.
message.sin.envy.message.0: You suddenly feel that everything others have is better than yours.
message.sin.envy.message.1: A pale green flame burns in eyes as deep and colorless as a dry well.
message.sin.envy.message.2: You start scheming on how to take what others hold dear.
message.sin.envy.message.3: Others' happiness now feels unbearable to you.
message.sin.lust.message.0: The hand that so desires to inflict wounds is tinged with the color of love.
message.sin.lust.message.1: Rose roots have climbed the spine, blooming dew-laden buds between the bones.
message.sin.lust.message.2: Blood drops fall between fingers, blossoming into blood roses on the ground.
message.sin.lust.message.3: Roses grow from wounds, each petal saturated with sweet, bloody desire.
message.sin.sloth.message.0: An overwhelming wave of fatigue suddenly hits; even breathing becomes laborious.
message.sin.sloth.message.1: Any action suddenly seems meaningless; better to just lie down.
message.sin.sloth.message.2: Limbs and body seem to feel an eternal weariness on their own.
message.sin.sloth.message.3: Time seems viscous, each second stretched into infinity.
message.sin.gloom.message.0: The sky is gray; even once-loved things lose their color.
message.sin.gloom.message.2: Memories are like faded photographs, blurring all warm details.
message.sin.gloom.message.3: Even the strength to speak sinks deep within the chest.

attribute.aces_spell_utils.mana_steal.de:
Mana Steal
Steals a percentage of mana from the target and restores the same percentage to the attacker.
attribute.aces_spell_utils.mana_rend.des:
Mana Rend
Deals bonus percentage damage to the target based on their current mana. Extra damage scales inversely with mana (similar to the Betrayer's Ring).
attribute.aces_spell_utils.goliath_slaye:
Giant Slayer
Deals bonus percentage damage to boss-type entities. (Entities tagged with c:bosses/ or aces_spell_utils:boss_like_entities are considered bosses.)
Hunger Steal
Steals a percentage of hunger based on damage dealt. If the target is a player, reduces their saturation by the same amount.
attribute.aces_spell_utils.spell_res_pen:
Spell Resistance Penetration
Increases spell damage based on the attacker's spell penetration and the target's spell resistance. The two values are added together, multiplied by the base damage, and added as bonus damage.
attribute.aces_spell_utils.evasive.desc:
Invulnerability Frames
Increases the duration of invulnerability frames after being hit, determined by the attribute value.
